summary: Ash plumes 100–600 m above the vent on 18–20 Oct and a dense black plume about 500 m high on 21 Oct; eruptive events and crater incandescence on 17 Oct. Alert Level 3 (of 1–4); 5 km exclusion zone.
Lava flow on the SW flank 514 m long by 15 Oct, advancing about 1 m per hour; ash plumes up to 860 m above the summit. Alert Level Yellow.

Intermittent minor ash emissions from 16 Oct, continuous low-energy steam, gas and ash by 20 Oct with vent temperatures up to about 395 °C; Volcanic Alert Level raised to 3 (of 0–5) and aviation code to Orange on 21 Oct.
Plumes of discoloured water drifting more than 7 km from the seamount on 9 and 11 Oct, likely from degassing; no signals on Wake Island hydrophones. Aviation Yellow / Advisory.
Sakurajima (Minamidake): 15 eruptive events on 12–19 Oct with ash plumes up to 2.2 km above the crater; nightly incandescence. Alert Level 3 (of 5).
Slow lava effusion continued to feed the summit-crater flow; small rockfalls from the advancing S flank of the dome. Watch / Orange.
Daily eruptive events with ash plumes 200–600 m above the summit. Alert Level 2 (of 1–4).
5–9 volcanic earthquakes and daily tremor; SO₂ 619–2,604 t/day; emissions up to 800 m and a brief ash emission on 18 Oct. Alert Level 2 (of 0–5); 4 km danger zone.
White plumes up to 1 km and a white-and-grey ash plume about 800 m high on 21 Oct; incandescence from lava flows and avalanches. Alert Level 2 (of 1–4).

Summit eruption continued; fountaining Episode 55 on 17 Oct reached 220 m with a plume to 7.6 km a.s.l., erupting about 7 million m³ of lava in nearly six hours before stopping. Alert Level lowered to Advisory/Yellow after the episode.
Ash plumes 200–400 m above the summit; active lava flows 500–600 m long on the SE flank. Alert Level 2 (of 1–4).
One eruptive event recorded seismically on 16 Oct (not observed). Alert Level 2 (of 1–4).
4–14 daily volcanic earthquakes; SO₂ 935–2,153 t/day; ash plume 400 m above the crater on 17 Oct. Alert Level 2 (of 0–5); 6 km danger zone.
Multiple lava avalanches daily, travelling up to 2.5 km down the SW and S flanks; SW dome about 4.2 million m³. Alert Level 3 (of 1–4).
Daily ash plumes to 4.9–6.1 km a.s.l. (up to 1.4 km above the summit) on 14–19 Oct. Alert Level Yellow.
High activity: 45–107 explosions per day, ash plumes up to 1.6 km above the crater, incandescent blocks rolling 1.2 km downslope and a pyroclastic flow on the S flank on 18 Oct. Alert Orange.
Gas, steam and ash emissions up to 1.2 km above the summit; SO₂ about 1,150 t/day; no explosions on 12–18 Oct. Alert Orange; 12 km exclusion radius.
0–33 explosions per day; ash plumes up to 3 km above the crater; incandescent material descending up to 800 m. Alert Yellow.
Daily eruptive events with ash plumes 300–1,000 m above the summit. Alert Level 3 (of 1–4); 5 km exclusion and 13 km along the Kobokan drainage.
Lava effusion and explosions; ash plumes to 9 km and 4.5 km a.s.l. on 15 Oct, drifting up to 460 km NE. Aviation code Orange.
Alert Level lowered to 2 (of 1–4) on 17 Oct; exclusion zone reduced to 3 km (4 km on the SE flank).
Eruptive events on 12 and 15 Oct with ash plumes up to 700 m; ashfall and rumbling within 5 km. Alert Level 2 (of 5).
Minor phreatic eruptions on 18, 20 and 21 Oct with plumes about 300 m high; 9–43 daily volcanic earthquakes; SO₂ up to about 1,000 t/day; tremor ongoing from 20 Oct. Alert Level 1 (of 0–5).
Ash plume to 1.2 km a.s.l. seen in webcam images on 18 Oct (Washington VAAC).
A pilot reported unspecified volcanic activity on 21 Oct (Wellington VAAC).
Activity decreased after a seismic increase from mid-August to mid-September; last eruption 6 Aug; Alert Level lowered to 2 (of 5) on 16 Oct.
Strong winds on 15 Oct resuspended 1980 ash into a plume up to 3.7 km a.s.l.; no eruption. Normal / Green.
